A kit's name links to its framework page once the page exists. Until then, the last column links to the kit's current docs. Each kit's page covers the same sections: the facts, install, the one-line flow, piecemeal parts, headless use, theming, localization, baselines and a sample.

## Kits

These kits cover the SDKs Polaris Key ships. A kit that is not built yet shows **Not built yet**.

<KitTable tier="must" />

## Parked kits

These kits are not built yet. Each follows the kit it extends.

<KitTable tier="should" />

## Recipes

A framework without a kit draws its own UI on the SDK's headless layer. These rows have no kit and no page.

| Framework                                   | Use                                                                              |
| ------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| SolidJS, Preact, Qwik, htmx and plain pages | [React SDK without React](/docs/build/sdks/react/your-own-ui/#without-react)     |
| wxPython, Kivy and the Python web UIs       | [The Python headless views](/docs/build/sdks/python/your-own-ui/#headless-views) |
